Vận chuyển các loại hàng hoá đường xa bằ.en: Transporting long-distance cargo by train is a choice chosen by the majority of customers. Rail transport has the most prominent advantage of cheap cost, goods secured with high safety. These two reasons give the railway priority. However, railway freight often takes longer time, more complicated procedures and needs more transport to the station.
Vận chuyển các loại hàng hoá đường xa bằ.zh: 由火车运送长途货物是大多数客户选择的一种选择. 铁路运输具有最显著的便宜成本优势,货物安全性高. 这两个原因赋予了铁路优先权. 然而,铁路货运往往需要较长的时间,更复杂的手续并需要更多的到站运输.
